1 Aim
1.1 This guide explains the sample relief under section 37B of the
Income Tax Act 1947 (“ITA”).
2 Conditions
2.1 A company may claim the relief if it meets the conditions in
section 37B(2) and section 37C.
2.2 The shareholding test is explained in paragraph
11.1 of another guide.
Table 1 – Conditions
1 Same group Both companies are in the same group
3.1 Assessable income
This is the income after deductions.

Company A has losses of $100.
